video_summary.overall_goal: Add a new medication entry by filling in product details, dates, dosage, and comment information
video_summary.description: User navigates through homemedkit1 app's medication list screen, taps the add button, and completes a medication form entry with multiple field inputs including product name, dates, display name, release form, and comment

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Medicine list view showing three medication items: 'dasd' (05/2026), 'ert' (05/2026, 45), and 'uyvhy Jbn nb' (07/2026, 6g). Bottom navigation shows Medicine, Intake, and Settings tabs. Green circular + button visible in bottom right.
visible_ui_elements: Filter and sort icons (menu, filter funnel)
Three medication list items with icons
Floating action button (+) for adding new item
steps.system_response: Menu popup appears with Scan and Add buttons
steps.navigation_change: Dialog overlay appears over medicine list
steps.visual_feedback: Popup with two action buttons (Scan and Add) and close button (X)
steps.intent_task: Open dialog to add new medication

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Dialog popup with 'Scan' and 'Add' buttons, and an X close button. Background shows dimmed medicine list.
steps.system_response: Dialog closes and medication form screen appears
steps.navigation_change: Navigate to medication form entry screen
steps.visual_feedback: New screen transitions in with form fields
steps.intent_task: Select manual add option (not scan)

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form screen with green header containing back arrow and checkmark button. Left side shows medicine bottle icon. Right side shows form fields: Product name (empty), Group (empty), Exp. date (empty), Package opened (empty). Below: Display name (Empty), Release form (Empty), Dose (0.5 mg + 84 mcg), Amount (Empty dropdown).
steps.system_response: Text field becomes focused with cursor visible
steps.visual_feedback: Keyboard not yet visible, field highlighted with green border
steps.intent_task: Focus on product name field to begin data entry

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form with Product name field focused, showing cursor. Text 'med' visible in the field.
visible_ui_elements: Product name field with cursor and partial text 'med'
Keyboard keys visible at bottom showing character suggestions
steps.system_response: Text is entered character by character
steps.visual_feedback: Text appears in field, keyboard suggestions shown
steps.intent_task: Type product name starting with 'med'

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Product name field shows 'medA' with cursor. Keyboard visible at bottom.
visible_ui_elements: Keyboard with SHIFT_LEFT, and character keys
steps.system_response: Final character 'A' is added to complete text
steps.visual_feedback: Full product name 'medA' displayed in field
steps.intent_task: Complete product name entry

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Dialog popup titled 'Medication groups' with message 'There are no groups found. You can add groups in the application settings.' Clear and Save buttons visible.
steps.system_response: Dialog appears informing no groups available
steps.visual_feedback: Error/info dialog displayed with options
steps.intent_task: Attempt to select or enter group, receive notification that no groups exist

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Dialog still visible with Clear and Save buttons. User interacts with dialog.
steps.system_response: Dialog closes and returns to form
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog closes, form becomes visible again
steps.intent_task: Close medication groups dialog by tapping Save

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Month/year selector dialog showing 2026 with months grid. May is highlighted (selected). Navigation arrows for year, Cancel and Save buttons.
visible_ui_elements: Month grid: JAN, FEB, MAR, APR, MAY (selected), JUN, JUL, AUG, SEP, OCT, NOV, DEC
steps.system_response: Date picker dialog appears with year 2026 and May selected
steps.visual_feedback: Month selector dialog displayed with May highlighted
steps.intent_task: Open date picker to select expiry date

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Calendar picker showing May 2026 with day 1 initially selected (circle), then day 23 becomes selected (filled circle). Calendar shows full month layout.
steps.system_response: Day 23 becomes selected (visual highlight changes)
steps.visual_feedback: Selection indicator moves from day 1 to day 23 with green circle fill
steps.intent_task: Select May 23, 2026 as expiry date

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Calendar picker showing May 23, 2026 selected. Same layout with day 23 highlighted.
steps.system_response: Calendar dialog closes and date is applied to form
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog closes, form displays selected date in Exp. date field
steps.intent_task: Confirm date selection and close picker

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Date selector dialog showing 'Selected date' and 'May 2026' with calendar. Day 1 is outlined (initial selection).
steps.system_response: Date picker dialog appears with May 2026 and day 1 selected
steps.visual_feedback: Calendar picker displayed for Package opened date
steps.intent_task: Open date picker for package opened date

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Calendar showing May 2026 with day 23 now selected (filled circle instead of outlined).
visible_ui_elements: Day 23 highlighted with filled green circle
steps.system_response: Day 23 becomes selected/highlighted
steps.visual_feedback: Day 23 selection indicator changes to filled circle
steps.intent_task: Select May 23, 2026 as package opened date

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Calendar showing May 2026 with day 23 selected (filled circle). Form fields visible behind dialog.
steps.system_response: Calendar closes and Package opened date is set to May 22, 2026
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog closes, form shows new date in Package opened field
steps.intent_task: Confirm package opened date selection

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form with scrolled view showing Display name field focused with cursor. Field shows placeholder 'Empty'. Keyboard visible at bottom.
visible_ui_elements: Display name text field with focus (green border)
steps.system_response: Field becomes focused and keyboard appears
steps.visual_feedback: Field highlighted with green border, cursor visible, keyboard ready
steps.intent_task: Click on Display name field to focus and prepare for text entry

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Display name field shows partial text 'm'. Keyboard visible with character suggestions.
steps.system_response: Character 'm' is entered into field
steps.visual_feedback: Text 'm' appears in Display name field
steps.intent_task: Type first character of display name

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Display name field shows 'medA' with cursor. Keyboard visible.
steps.system_response: Remaining characters entered to complete 'medA'
steps.visual_feedback: Complete text 'medA' displayed in Display name field
steps.intent_task: Complete display name entry

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form showing Release form field focused (green border). Field shows placeholder 'Empty'. Display name field above shows 'medA'.
visible_ui_elements: Release form text field with focus (green border)
steps.system_response: Release form field becomes focused
steps.visual_feedback: Field highlighted with green border, ready for input
steps.intent_task: Focus on Release form field for data entry

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Release form field shows partial text 'med'. Keyboard visible at bottom with character suggestions.
steps.system_response: Text 'med' is entered into Release form field
steps.visual_feedback: Text 'med' appears in Release form field
steps.intent_task: Begin typing release form value

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Release form field shows 'medB' with cursor. Keyboard visible with character suggestions.
steps.system_response: Final character 'B' is added to complete entry
steps.visual_feedback: Complete text 'medB' displayed in Release form field
steps.intent_task: Complete release form entry with 'medB'

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form scrolls down showing Dose, Amount, Usage indications, and Comment fields. Comment field eventually becomes visible and focused with green border.
steps.system_response: Form scrolls down to reveal lower fields
steps.visual_feedback: Screen scrolls to show Comment field
steps.intent_task: Scroll down to access Comment field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Comment field focused (green border) with partial text 'abc'. Keyboard visible showing character suggestions.
visible_ui_elements: Keyboard at bottom showing character keys
steps.system_response: Text 'abc' is entered into Comment field
steps.visual_feedback: Text 'abc' displayed in Comment field
steps.intent_task: Type comment text 'abc'

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form showing complete medication entry with all fields filled. Green checkmark button visible at top right. Details visible: Product name 'medA', Display name 'medA', Release form 'medB', Dose 0.5 mg + 84 mcg, Amount 0, Comment 'abc'. Status shows 'Added manually' in red text.
steps.system_response: Form is submitted and medication entry is saved
steps.navigation_change: Navigate back to medication details view
steps.visual_feedback: Screen transitions to show saved medication details in read-only view
steps.intent_task: Submit and save the medication entry

overall_flow: Tap floating action button to open add menu
Attempt to select group (shows no groups available dialog)
Select expiry date May 31, 2026 using month/year picker then calendar
Select package opened date May 22, 2026 using calendar
Scroll down to access comment field
Submit medication form by tapping checkmark button
View completed medication entry with status 'Added manually'
human_readable_step_summary: User views medicine list showing three existing medications
User taps floating + button which opens a popup menu
User selects 'Add' option to manually add a new medication
Medication form appears with multiple fields to complete
User types 'medA' into the Product name field
User attempts to select a medication group, but dialog indicates no groups exist
User confirms and closes the medication groups dialog
User opens and navigates month/year picker to select May 2026
User selects day 23 from the calendar for expiry date
User confirms and applies the expiry date (May 31, 2026 shown in form)
User opens calendar picker for package opened date
User selects day 23 for package opened date
User confirms and applies package opened date (May 22, 2026 shown in form)
User enters display name 'medA' in the Display name field
User enters release form value 'medB' in the Release form field
User scrolls down the form to access the Comment field
User enters comment text 'abc' in the Comment field
User reviews the completed form showing all entered data
User taps the green checkmark button to submit the medication entry
Medication entry is saved and displayed in detail view with 'Added manually' status
